PROJECTILE.name: PROJECTILE
PROJECTILE.desc: Fires a bolt along the aim direction. The standard ranged form.

SLASH.name: SLASH
SLASH.desc: An instant short arc at the aim direction. Fast, but reach is short.

DASHSLASH.name: SWIFT STRIKE
DASHSLASH.desc: Lunges along the aim direction, cutting everything on the path.

FIRE.name: FIRE
FIRE.desc: Adds flame. Struck enemies burn for damage over time; a wet one is only dried.

ICE.name: ICE
ICE.desc: Adds frost. Struck enemies are slowed; a wet one freezes solid for a moment.

WATER.name: WATER
WATER.desc: Soaks what it strikes. A wet enemy freezes solid under ICE, and FIRE only dries it; water puts a burning enemy out.

DAMAGE.name: DAMAGE +
DAMAGE.desc: Raises damage, and each one stacked raises it by more than the last. Stable and simple, but interacts with little else.

SIZE.name: SIZE x
SIZE.desc: Scales the attack by 1.6. Melee arcs widen and reach further. Stacks up to 3.

SPEED.name: SPEED x
SPEED.desc: Bolts leave 1.5x faster. They also carry further before they fade, and are harder to dodge. Does nothing to any other attack. Stacks up to 4, and at 4 a bolt flies at laser speed.

RANGE.name: RANGE x
RANGE.desc: Bolts carry 1.75x as far before they fade, and SWIFT STRIKE lunges 1.75x as far. Does nothing to any other attack. Stacks up to 3, which is the most range there is.

SHATTER.name: SHATTER
SHATTER.desc: Breaks the frost on an enemy slowed by it: the hit lands far harder, and the enemy thaws. Each one stacked breaks harder still. Worth nothing on its own — pair it with ICE, or with a board that lands twice.

PIERCE.name: PIERCE
PIERCE.desc: The attack passes through one enemy and carries on to the next. Each one stacked is one more enemy it passes through.

HOMING.name: HOMING
HOMING.desc: Tracks the nearest enemy. Bolts curve and find their way round walls; melee forms re-aim themselves. Each one stacked turns a bolt tighter, so it holds a winding path it would otherwise fly wide of.

GRAVITY.name: GRAVITY
GRAVITY.desc: The enemy struck is not knocked back but pinned, and every other enemy nearby is dragged onto it. Gathers a room into one place for whatever comes next. Each one stacked drags harder.

KNOCKBACK.name: KNOCKBACK
KNOCKBACK.desc: Hits throw the enemy back the way the attack was going. Buys room, but can put it out of reach. Each one stacked throws harder.

MANA_DRAIN.name: MANA DRAIN
MANA_DRAIN.desc: Every enemy this attack connects with gives mana back to the caster. What pays for the next charge is landing hits, not waiting. Each one stacked drains more.

HEALTH_DRAIN.name: HEALTH DRAIN
HEALTH_DRAIN.desc: Every enemy this attack hurts gives health back to the caster: a fifth of the damage dealt, and a fifth more for each one stacked. What keeps you standing is landing hits.

STUN.name: STUN
STUN.desc: Struck enemies are stunned: for a moment they stand where they are and cannot attack. Each one stacked holds them longer. Once it wears off, an enemy shrugs off the next stun for a while.

POSSESS.name: POSSESS
POSSESS.desc: Takes over the monster struck for 5 seconds, unharmed, longer for each one stacked. Your keys move it; it fights with its own attack, or your weapon once it takes it from your body, left behind and still hunted. Bosses resist it.

AUTO_AIM.name: AUTO-AIM
AUTO_AIM.desc: Aims the attack at the nearest enemy, wherever you point: bolts go straight at it and SWIFT STRIKE lunges through it, as far as each reaches, and a swing turns to it. Each one stacked looks further for one.

EXPLODE.name: EXPLODE
EXPLODE.desc: Every enemy the attack hits bursts, and everything round it takes the hit too. Each one stacked bursts wider. A trigger's branch starts without it, and one with no form but an EXPLODE on it bursts where it goes off.

DUPLICATE.name: DUPLICATE x3
DUPLICATE.desc: Produces the same result three times at full damage. Generates a lot of heat.

OVERCLOCK.name: OVERCLOCK
OVERCLOCK.desc: Runs the whole board on a faster clock, at the price of a settling delay between cycles. Each one adds less speed than the last while the delay grows faster, so a few pay off and a wall of them does not.

DELAY.name: DELAY
DELAY.desc: One cell of waiting and nothing more: it turns a flow and leaves it as it was. Steer a flow round to the way out with it, or walk a trigger's branch round a ring and back.

TIME_DILATION.name: TIME DILATION
TIME_DILATION.desc: Slows the world and the board alike. Not a speed buff — a change in the pace of the fight.

INVERT.name: INVERT
INVERT.desc: Turns the part right before it inside out: DAMAGE heals what it strikes, FIRE, ICE and STUN cleanse it, GRAVITY pushes away, KNOCKBACK pulls in, and SIZE, SPEED and RANGE shrink. After anything else it does nothing.

ON_HIT.name: ON HIT
ON_HIT.desc: Runs the branch flow as a payload when this skill connects.

ON_KILL.name: ON KILL
ON_KILL.desc: Runs the branch flow as a payload only when this skill kills.

ON_PARRY.name: ON PARRY
ON_PARRY.desc: Opens a brief guard window as the flow passes. Absorbing a hit there runs the branch flow.
